body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> Samsung introduced ''auto wall mount'' system during CES 2007, which allows users to move the direction of TV up and down (20-degree) and from left to right(30-dgree) with a remote control.
< AVING Special Report Team for 2007 International CES: Editor & Publisher, Brain Park, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Rose Kim, Niki Hwang, Alliyah Seo, Jun Lee, Daniel Sirh >
